capability:
The whole protocol is **one endpoint, two calls per model call**. You forward
the exact bodies you already send to and receive from your LLM
What the enforcement point must DO before an action proceeds — carried beside an `allow`
What an in-process integration does so a secret never leaves the host — mask on the way out, restore into a tool, rules served by the runtime
How multiple detectors' answers combine into one decision
DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) | [`integrations/agent/dsh`](integrations/agent/dsh/) — **the reference agent-direct integration**
Higress (Go/WASM) | [`integrations/gateway/higress`](integrations/gateway/higress/) — **the reference gateway integration**

The [benchmark](benchmarks/) evaluates conformant detectors on shared corpora
  and publishes the leaderboard.

A detector is **OGR-conformant** if it accepts a `GuardEvent` and returns a
  valid `Verdict` against the [JSON Schemas](schema/).

Risk categories live in the [taxonomy](specification/taxonomy.md) (`safety.*` and
`security.*`), versioned and swappable

Fail-open by

| GitHub down | Local + iCloud dual backup |

capability: **Multiple time windows**: add / remove pause-resume windows freely; supports midnight-crossing windows (23:00–08:00) and per-weekday filtering

**Automatic pause on schedule**: when the pause time arrives, running tasks are safely "frozen" (their progress is preserved exactly — nothing is interrupted or lost) and resume automatically when the window ends
**No requests during the window (the saving core)**: inside a pause window the AI sends no new requests to the model service, so **no cost is incurred**
**Per-model-tier save mode**: decide per model tier which ones pause during windows.
**Global weekday switch**: one row above the window list — 一 ☑️ 二 ☑️ 三 ☑️ 四 ☑️ 五 ☑️ 六 ⬜ 日 ⬜.
**End this save mode (one-shot, current window only)**: the banner and settings-popover button end the **currently active** pause window only
**Timezone support**: IANA timezone dropdown, browser auto-detection with Beijing time (+8) fallback
**One-click DeepSeek preset**: dedupe-append the peak windows (**08:58–12:02, 13:58–18:02**, with a 2-minute boundary margin
**Account balance display (optional)**: tick "Show balance" in settings and your official DeepSeek account balance appears next to the status text in the header
**Spend bar chart (last 8 hours, per 10 minutes)**: click the balance to open a chart of the last 48 ten-minute windows.
**Spend statistics**: with the balance display enabled, the backend samples the balance every 5 minutes (288 points covering the last 24 hours).
usageItems: click the **"Save · 🟢 Working"** status text in the top-right of the session header (next to the Session log) to open settings
Click **One-click DeepSeek peak/off-peak savings** → the peak windows are added automatically
You can also configure through the tools in a conversation (`save_money_configure`, `save_money_status`).
usageActions: `save_money_status` | Query state / **gate state (gate: open\|closed)** / window / pause record / UTC projection
| `save_money_configure` | Configure (enabled / timezone / warnMinutes / windows) |
| `save_money_end_window` | End save mode for the currently active window only (one-shot, in-memory): resume now / cancel the upcoming pause; next windows still take effect |
usecases: Built for LLM API **peak/off-peak pricing** (e.g. DeepSeek peak hours 9:00–12:00, 14:00–18:00 Beijing time, off-peak at half price; since **2026-08-23 weekends are off-peak all day**
equally useful for time-of-use electricity rates, bandwidth off-peak shifting, or any "I don't want the machine working during this period" scenario.
outputs: Hover the balance to see **how much was spent in the last 1 hour / 10 minutes / 24 hours** (balance increases from top-ups or refunds show as "+amount")
reliability: **if nothing is running, nothing is paused**;
Any model whose name carries no flash/pro/vision marker (legacy `chat`/`reasoner`, unknown models, anything else) is always exempt — it can never block your requests;
all settings are saved automatically to the workspace file `save-money.config.json` (gitignored); configuration survives browser refresh and plugin disable/re-activate
**External-spend attribution** — a window where the balance dropped without any local model activity is marked with a warning color
**Balance top-ups (recharges / refunds) are never drawn as bars and never stretch the Y axis**
The file is keyed by a fingerprint of the API key — **changing the key discards the old history** automatically
**Non-intrusive by design**: no screen lock, no overlay blocking, no user action prevented
Plugin fails to load with `ReferenceError: harness is not defined` | You are running a build older than **v1.2.2**
UI shows but the **Enable checkbox (and other settings) do nothing** | You are running a build older than **v1.2.5**
Deleting the config file resets all settings.
